metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and mods by Marc Mayol: Meter for Claude Code, your plan usage (5h, 7d and an estimated month) at the bottom right; Context Bar, the context window filling up towards auto-compact; Creality Print, slice and run Creality printers from Claude Code; Humanizar, clean and score Spanish text so it doesn't read like AI; Omoikane, long-term memory with automatic recall.

plugins.name: meter-for-claude-code
plugins.description: Plan usage at the bottom right of the prompt: 5-hour session, weekly window and an estimated month (M), calibrated from your own transcripts.

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: The session's context window as a bar in the footer, with a mark where auto-compact kicks in: green, amber as it nears the compact, red right before it.

plugins.name: creality-print
plugins.description: Slice with Creality Print, check gcode, handle colours and the CFS, and run Creality OS printers (K2, K1…). Unofficial.

plugins.name: humanizar
plugins.description: Clean and score Spanish text (0-100) so it doesn't read like AI: invisible characters, Unicode bold, filler, "it's not X, it's Y", em dashes, hashtag walls. Local heuristics, no API.

plugins.name: omoikane
plugins.description: Long-term memory for Claude Code: what it learns in one session comes back in the next. Local SQLite, duplicate detection, and automatic recall of the memories that matter for each prompt. Needs the omoi binary.
